searchText: Any strong opinions on the API path? BTW in this initial impl in Lighthouse there is no persistance of proofs expecting proofs to be recursive, so I can't serve historical proofs on the API. From your PR I would only merge submitExecutionProofs for now or only support that one for now Would it be practical to serve proofs from the gossip cache. Constrain the serve range to unfinalized? I suppose this would require a read lock per beacon api req but maybe that’s fine? The practical requirement for this is to allow Dora explorer to fetch and display proofs - Dora will do storage and indexing
